items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: He used to call those streets, Donnie.

ctx.x: On two row between Ramport and Burgundy. That's right over on the other side of Claiborne. That's right. That's most on the French part of town. That's right. Coming from the Vicare, about nine blocks from the Vicare. Where was he born? Was he born in the city? Yeah, he was born in the city. Where was he born? Do you remember where he was born? What street or where? Yeah, I was born on... Union Street. Union Street.
That's what he had. He used to call those streets, Donnie. Union and what? Union and what?
What was Union Street after Union Street? What they call it, street? That wasn't St. Claude, huh?
